producer_report.summary: Changed only CHANGELOG.md. athena.toml already held every target value, so it was left as is. No crates/ file or test was touched, and job_usd stays at 50.00. The Unreleased entry now lists each lifted cap with its old and new value and says it follows the owner's 4 Nov direction. The earlier bullet said tests had been updated, which is false under this reading, so I replaced it. Arithmetic: reader 2 + producer 10 + verifier 5 + max_rounds 5 × (planner 3 + critic 3) = 47 <= job_usd 50, so admission's reserve check passes. The root cause of the rejected retry was setting job_usd to 60 when the tests pin 50; keeping 50 removes the need for any test edit.
